independence_statement: Independent-topic rows were authored as a separate exploration rather than expansions of seed tags or SLOP prompts. The implementation author has seen the seed; this is not a blind independent human corpus.
limitations: A finite purposive corpus, not the universe of visual subjects.
36 independent-topic probes and 12 seed-derived controls are reported separately.
